description: Supplementary input and final-design examples cover two 109-pipe Chico Sur variants and a Moeini-Afshar benchmark for sewer designs with in-line pumping. This resource is provided by Juan Saldarriaga; Juana Herrán; Yesid Coy and coauthors. Coverage is global as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. Access is through the linked repository or provider page; the exact file formats are not fully established. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: The examples support one publication and should not be assumed to represent real operational networks. For simulation, it can supply inputs or comparison evidence. Related catalogue record: model-iwa-benchmark-simulation-models. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
